headings.usage: Use for all main and sub-headings. H1 maximum is text-5xl.

body.usage: Use for body text, descriptions, and labels.

mono.usage: Use for code, IDs, or technical data.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle borders (border-border) on cards and grids
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient subtle shadows. On hover: shadow-lg with -translate-y-1
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not recommended for main dashboard content. Use flat solid surfaces.

grids_layouts.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision.
grids_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content and forms.

motion.hover_states: Required on all interactive elements. Slight lift for cards (-translate-y-1).
motion.focus_states: High contrast ring focus for accessibility.
motion.global_transitions: Do not use 'transition: all'. Apply to specific properties like transform and opacity.

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast ratios must be met. Normal text >= 4.5:1, Large text >= 3:1.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

components.name: Card
components.usage: Use for grouping related content. Flat background, border-border, no shadow by default.

components.name: Button
components.usage: Pill-shaped or rounded-md. Hover must explicitly set background and text colors.

components.name: Progress
components.usage: Use to display training completion progress.

components.name: Dialog
components.usage: Use for create/assign training modals instead of inline forms where appropriate.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT redesign the existing application. Ensure you preserve existing ESG/GHG and Documents architecture.
Integrate the Training module into the existing Supplier layout and routing.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or surfaces that have content under them.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid.
Use 'supplier-assessment-dev' instead of 'organization-facility-data-dev' for R2 uploads related to training.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the generic 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make UI distinctive without breaking the existing theme.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
